name: World helium supply by plant (Ras Laffan, Amur GPP, US BLM Cliffside)
description: Ras Laffan (Qatar): about 75-81 million m3/yr across three plants - roughly a third of world supply; Amur GPP (Russia): about 45-50 million m3/yr (designed up to 60 Mm3/yr); US BLM Cliffside (Amarillo, Texas) enrichment units; world production capacity about 360 million m3 (13 bcf) per year in 2023 (USGS)

sources.note: USGS Minerals Yearbook 2023, helium chapter (world capacity 360 Mm3/yr); portfolio-pplus industry article 15 Mar 2026 (Ras Laffan 75-81, Amur 45-50 Mm3/yr); qatarenergylng.qa (three helium plants at Ras Laffan); read 2026-10-28
